title: A contract deploy whose authorization root carries a 245-deep chain
pattern: The deploy succeeds and creates an instance; its auth root is the CreateContractV2 function with 244 nested never-called invocations. wallet-backend's contract-deploy walk (#820) runs only when an instance is created, so this is the ledger that exercises it.
